notes: A hand-written fake model output, not a real writer's: replace it with a live run's (--import-live). Steps 2 and 3 are scenarios of one step, one per phone.

script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Kiran from Janata Cooperative Bank. Your KYC is due, and I can help you update it in our app in a few minutes. Can you talk now?

stages.name: App and phone
stages.instruction: Ask whether they have the bank app on their phone, and whether it is Android or iPhone.

scripts.en-IN: Do you have our bank app on your phone?

branches.when: They do not have the app

stages.name: Android path
stages.instruction: On Android, guide them one screen at a time: open the app, go to Profile, tap Update KYC.

procedure.action: Now tap Profile at the bottom.

stages.name: iPhone path
stages.instruction: On iPhone, guide them one screen at a time: open the app, tap the Settings tab, then KYC.

stages.name: Upload the PAN
stages.instruction: Have them upload a clear photo of their PAN card. Never ask for a PIN, password or OTP.

scripts.en-IN: Tell me your PAN number and I will update it for you.

stages.name: Request number
stages.instruction: Ask them to read out the request number the app shows.

scripts.en-IN: The app now shows a request number. Could you read it out to me?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and end the call.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you, your KYC request is sent.

step_outcomes.outcome: Whether they have the app and their phone type are known.
The person has tapped Update KYC under Profile on Android.
The request number is read out.
